title: Installation Jobs: Quick Rebooking After a Failed-Access Visit
content:
**Quick rebooking after a failed-access visit — Installation Jobs**

A failed-access visit on an **Installation Jobs** record that was rebooked quickly costs Ridgeline less. The failed-access fee for the visit is multiplied by a rebooking share set by the new crew date recorded on that failed-access visit:

| New crew date recorded on the failed-access visit | Rebooking share |
|---|---|
| 3 days or fewer after the failed visit | 0.8 |
| 4 to 7 days after the failed visit | 0.9 |
| more than 7 days after, or no new date | one |

The visit considered is the most recent failed-access visit recorded on the job, the visit being charged. The days are calendar days from the crew date of the failed visit to the new crew date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Failed visit | New crew date | Days after | Rebooking share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 13 March | 3 | 0.8 |
| 10 March | 14 March | 4 | 0.9 |
| 10 March | 17 March | 7 | 0.9 |
| 10 March | 18 March | 8 | one |
| 10 March | none | — | one |
